newsitem.title: HONG KONG: South Sea hit high on takeover rumours.
newsitem.headline: South Sea hit high on takeover rumours.

text.p: South Sea Development Co Ltd shares hit a new year high of HK$0.54 each on rumours of a possible takeover bid, brokers said on Friday.
"Rumours that the company was in talks regarding sale of a controllling stake fueled speculation of a possible buy out offer," said a sales manager at local brokerage.
The company had said earlier on Friday that it was not aware of any reason behind the recent rise in its share price and it confirmed that no price sensitive negotiations were undergoing.
Its shares rose HK$0.035 or 8.05 percent to HK$0.47 in late morning on volume of 29.20 million shares.
South Sea also said it was still in negotiation to sell a total of 93 percent interest in Acesite (Phils) Hotel Corp but no binding agreement had been reached.
Acesite is a subsidiary of South Sea, and owns and operates the Holiday Inn Manila Pavilion Hotel in the Philippines.
